title: Country search results take the design's own screen-reader wording, if design says the component's own cannot stand
detail: The target design labels the country results 'Country search results' for screen readers and announces 'Selected <country>' when one is chosen. The 9 October afternoon ruling builds the accessible autocomplete's own result and selection announcements now, and puts this custom wording to design as question 13. If design says the component's own announcements cannot stand, the origin page of each animals set and of the high-risk plants journey takes the custom wording; otherwise this row is dropped. There is no safe default to build, so it waits on design.
acceptanceCriteria: With JavaScript, on the live animals origin page, the germinal products origin page and the high-risk plants origin page, the country results are labelled 'Country search results' for screen readers (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-033; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p2-036; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-015, p1-058, p3-032; conflicts:c-009)

With JavaScript, choosing a country on any of those three origin pages announces 'Selected <country>' to a screen reader, for example 'Selected France' (prototype:dr2-1-source prototype-dr2-1-source-p2-033; trace:prototype-dr2-1 trace-prototype-dr2-1-p2-037, p12-009; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p1-014, p1-058; conflicts:c-009)

With Welsh chosen, the results label and the selection announcement show their Welsh counterparts on each of those three origin pages (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p4-117; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p5-028)
openQuestions: Design question 13: design must say whether the accessible autocomplete's own result and selection announcements can stand. The custom wording is built only if design says they cannot; otherwise this row is dropped. No safe default: the ruling puts it to design.
notes: Keeps inc-189, rewritten only where the requirement has moved on: it now names the germinal products set's origin page as well, because req-020 covers the origin page of both animals sets, and the criteria are split so that the results label and the selection announcement are checked separately. Kept apart from any Search-button row because it waits on a different design question; if the arrival-and-transit area drafts the same question for the port and transit boxes, the combiner may merge them into one waiting-on-design row. The wording is a change to the shared accessible-autocomplete wrapper's options in each frontend (src/client/javascripts/components/accessible-autocomplete.js, kept identical in both), plus the origin pages' copy keys, so it is listed under shared rather than touches: journey-foundation and design-snagging both own parts of that wrapper on their own branches, and design snagging has already reworked it on main (page placeholder, bolded matches through templates.suggestion, decorative joined search span, change event on confirm, the selectText and searchPlaceholder copy keys). The germinal products clause can only be observed once the germinal products set's origin page exists, which the germinal-products theme builds: that is a real ordering need for the combiner to record, not a criterion that cannot be observed. This row's existing theme is waiting-on-design, which sources.json's goal reserves for JavaScript-only prototype behaviour blocked on design, one increment per design question; the requirements behind it have not moved to another theme's code, so it keeps that theme, and waiting-on-design's touches do not claim the autocomplete wrapper, so no theme overlap arises.
